public_notes.title: Language Practice And Artisans In 2020
public_notes.text: The Nation's Word of the Month post looks back at language practice and proposes a new calendar of practice for February 2020. A separate January notice proposes featuring enrolled citizens' crafted items in public posts. Together, these posts record the Nation choosing how to share language learning and creative work. They are dated accounts of practice and plans, rather than proof of a current program or a current invitation for submissions.

public_notes.title: Community Space Plans In 2021
public_notes.text: A March 2021 notice planned a gathering in Guntersville to tour the land and discuss an office building and a PowWow area. A November post reported that work on the project had started. These are the Nation's own accounts of its community space priorities. The first describes a plan; the second reports a beginning. Neither establishes the project's present condition, completed facilities or a current opportunity to attend or volunteer.
